base_setup_commands: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq python3 python3-venv python3-pip python3-dev git curl
setup_runtime_commands: pip install --no-cache-dir 'setuptools>=41.0.0' six mock wheel cython
pip install --no-cache-dir hypothesis pyyaml pytest matplotlib
pip install --no-cache-dir 'pillow>=9.0' lmdb ck==1.55.5 absl-py pycocotools typing_extensions
pip install --no-cache-dir scikit-build && pip uninstall -y enum34 2>/dev/null || true
pip install --no-cache-dir requests tqdm boto3 iopath unidecode inflect toml
runtime_smoke_command: python -c "import librosa; print(librosa.__version__); import torch; print(torch.__version__)"

prepare_commands: pip install -r requirements.txt 2>/dev/null || pip install numpy scipy librosa torch
runtime_profile.notes: Python 3.10+ virtualenv with MLCommons RNNT speech recognition dependencies. librosa==0.10.0 is the key dependency with API compatibility fixes. PyTorch 2.2.0 for inference. The actual AArch64 Docker build compiles PyTorch from source with ARM optimizations, but standard wheels work for x86_64 testing.

notes: MLCommons RNNT speech recognition benchmark environment. The fix addresses librosa API compatibility issues where function signatures changed in newer versions (requiring keyword arguments like sr=, orig_sr=, target_sr=, top_db=, n_fft=). Also fixes torch.stft return_complex handling and numpy array dtype for coco.py. Base image is ubuntu:22.04 with Python 3.10+. The virtual environment is at /opt/benchmark/mlcommons-venv. Git and curl are included in system packages. The repo uses pip with virtualenv, not conda. Note: pillow 6.1 from original Dockerfile is incompatible with Python 3.11, so pillow>=9.0 is used instead.
